upstream_digest_amd64__command: json=$(cat meta.json) && upstream_image=$(jq -re '.upstream_image' <<< "${json}") && upstream_tag=$(jq -re '.upstream_tag' <<< "${json}") && if ! test -f cache-page1.json; then skopeo inspect --raw "docker://${upstream_image}:${upstream_tag}" > cache-page1.json; fi && cat cache-page1.json | jq -re '.manifests[] | select (.platform.architecture == "amd64" and .platform.os == "linux").digest'
upstream_digest_arm64__command: json=$(cat meta.json) && upstream_image=$(jq -re '.upstream_image' <<< "${json}") && upstream_tag=$(jq -re '.upstream_tag' <<< "${json}") && if ! test -f cache-page1.json; then skopeo inspect --raw "docker://${upstream_image}:${upstream_tag}" > cache-page1.json; fi && cat cache-page1.json | jq -re '.manifests[] | select (.platform.architecture == "arm64" and .platform.os == "linux").digest'
